//: Repository-local Deno configuration for the Supabase Edge Functions.
It exists so a FRESH CHECKOUT resolves backend dependencies identically on
any machine. Before this file, `npm:unpdf@1.8.1` (the serverless pdf.js
build used by the label text extractor) resolved against whatever npm
metadata the developer's machine happened to have, including a
package-lock.json sitting in a HOME directory above the repository.
That is not reproducible and is not reviewable.
* `lock` pins the resolved npm tree, with integrity hashes, in the
committed deno.lock next to this file.
* `nodeModulesDir: none` stops Deno inferring an npm project from any
package.json ABOVE the repository root, which is exactly how the
home-level lockfile leaked into backend runs.
The extractor keeps importing the fully-qualified `npm:unpdf@1.8.1`
specifier, so the version pin is stated at the import site as well as here.
